summary: fortinet.fortios in Ansible 12.1.0 added support for FortiOS 7.6.3 and 7.6.4 and username/password authentication on 7.6.4.
questions: Can I use username and password authentication with FortiOS 7.6.4 in Ansible?

answer_card.title: fortinet.fortios supports 7.6.3 and 7.6.4
answer_card.answer_md: In Ansible 12.1.0, `fortinet.fortios` added support for FortiOS **7.6.3 and 7.6.4**, including username/password authentication on 7.6.4.
